persona: Early-stage fund or angel focused on infrastructure and developer productivity.
use_case: Screen new deals that match a technical-founder, dev-tools thesis and review memo + drift outputs.
thesis_raw: Pre-seed developer tools startups with strong technical founders building B2B products for US engineering teams.
sample_chat_prompts: What should I diligence first for a seed B2B SaaS?
How do I assess technical moat in a code-review startup?
